description: This file implements a service class 'ConfigService' for managing application configurations and feature toggles in a backend API. It provides methods for CRUD operations on configurations and toggles, filtering, bulk updates, and runtime config retrieval. The class interacts with database models and schemas, and handles permissions and filtering logic.

classes.description: Service class for configuration and feature toggle management.
